transitions.trigger: Operator submits TargetCriteria search query via UI Wizard
transitions.action: Activate designated starting cameras to SEARCHING NEIGHBOR, all other 6 cameras remain IDLE

transitions.trigger: Candidate detected on starting camera with multi-modal score >= acquisition_threshold (0.65)
transitions.action: Lock target, initialize target embedding bank, assign ACTIVE state to lock camera, set all others to IDLE

transitions.trigger: Target intersects an exit zone OR is lost in active camera for time_lost > lost_timeout_sec (1.5s)
transitions.action: Record departure time, awaken topological neighbor cameras to SEARCHING NEIGHBOR, set active camera to LOW_RATE_CHECK, others IDLE

transitions.trigger: Candidate re-acquired in neighbor camera within physical transit window [T_min, T_max] with fusion score >= reacquisition_fusion_threshold (0.55)
transitions.action: Handoff active camera to neighbor (ACTIVE), append to camera path, update embedding bank, return previous camera to IDLE

transitions.trigger: Target enters terminal exit zone OR neighbor search timeout expires (elapsed > neighbor_search_timeout_sec = 30.0s) OR timeline reaches video end
transitions.action: Emit FinalVerdict (inferred location, camera path, confidence), transition all cameras to IDLE (0% GPU)
Clear target bank, clear path, clear audit timeline, reset timeline to t=0.0

issues.description: cam8 lists cam5 as a neighbor in web/static/js/app.js (line 28) and PROJECT_EXPLAINER.md (Table 5.1), but cam5 does not list cam8. Furthermore, cam8 -> cam5 does not exist in configs/topology.yaml and physically bypasses 2nd Floor.

cam5 has 'cam4' in its topological neighbors list and has transit bounds defined for cam4 [2.0, 25.0], but cam5 defines no exit zone to handoff to cam4 (only 'Stairs Down to Ground' pointing to cam3).

configs/topology.yaml maps cam5 (1F Landing) to 'data/videos/CAM 6.mp4' and cam6 (GF North Walkway) to 'data/videos/CAM 5.mp4'. This was done because CAM 6.mp4 contains CCTV Channel 5 and CAM 5.mp4 contains CCTV Channel 8, but it contradicts the 1-to-1 file naming convention and the fallback in src/topology_tracker.py.

cam8 FOV angle is configured as 180 deg in configs/topology.yaml and visually drawn pointing West (180 deg) on terrace.png, but is hardcoded as 270 deg (pointing North) in web/static/js/app.js (line 15) and PROJECT_EXPLAINER.md (line 235).

All 8 cameras have time_offset_sec set to 0.0 in configs/topology.yaml, yet CCTV watermarks on frame 0 reveal real-world clock offsets up to 27 seconds: CAM 7 (05:45:00), CAM 3 (+1s), CAM 4 (+1s), CAM 2 (+2s), CAM 8 (+3s), CAM 1 (+5s), CAM 5 (+12s), CAM 6 (+27s).

Global timeline assumes 900.0s (15 min) duration, but CAM 8.mp4 is only 631.88s (10.5 min, 9477 frames). CAM 1.mp4 is 839.56s (14.0 min), CAM 6.mp4 is 885.84s (14.8 min), CAM 2.mp4 is 897.00s, CAM 3.mp4 is 898.00s, and CAM 4.mp4 is 898.00s. Seeking past 631s stalls or loops cam8.

Terminal 'Room / Store' is configured on cam2 (SE Gate) with box [0.0, 0.7, 0.3, 1.0], which covers outdoor driveway brick paving and ferns. The architectural floorplan locates Room/Store on the far west side adjacent to cam4. cam4 has no exit zone for Room/Store.

On cam3, 'Main Gate Exit' and 'To SE Gate' are placed at [0.7, 0.7, 1.0, 1.0] and [0.6, 0.6, 0.95, 0.95] (bottom-right over a parked scooter), whereas the physical apartment gate is in the upper background [0.2, 0.0, 0.8, 0.3].

On cam5 and cam7, residential flat door exit zones ('Flat 1A', 'Flat 2A') are placed on the left [0.0, 0.3, 0.28, 0.75] directly over ascending stairs, while 'Stairs Up' zones are placed at top center [0.35, 0.0, 0.65, 0.3] over apartment door frames.
On cam8, 'Terrace Area' [0.0, 0.0, 0.4, 0.6] and 'Terrace Door' [0.7, 0.35, 0.95, 0.7] cover interior windows and solid side walls rather than the corridor doorway.
On cam1 and cam6, walkway handoff boxes are placed on solid building corners, windows, and electric meters rather than the open perspective walkway.

web/app.py DEMO_PROFILES defines transitions absent from configs/topology.yaml: cam5 -> cam2 (profile_1, jumping 1F to GF gate with 280s gap), cam3 -> cam6 (profile_2, profile_3), and cam6 -> cam7 (profile_2, profile_3, jumping GF north walkway to 2F landing bypassing 1F).

Cameras cam1, cam4, and cam6 contain zero terminal exit zones. When target disappears on these cameras and transit timeout expires, destination resolution produces generic placeholders ('Terminal Zone in ...') rather than known architectural destinations.

Gallery update quality gate in src/topology_tracker.py (line 770) accepts crops with target_quality >= 0.40, whereas PROJECT_EXPLAINER.md (line 189) specifies high quality Q >= 0.65 and fusion score S_fuse >= 0.75.
Detection conf_threshold in configs/default.yaml is 0.35, whereas PROJECT_EXPLAINER.md (line 87) specifies tau_conf >= 0.40.
